rule_metadata.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
rule_metadata.title: HackTool - Defendnot Installation via PowerShell One-Liner

rules.rule_text:
title: HackTool - Defendnot Installation via PowerShell One-Liner
id: 50b159ba-a147-40f7-9d11-561e724b8a2e
related:
- id: 0aaa9689-9f38-491d-bd4d-a9af6eb43138
  type: similar
status: experimental
description: 'Detects execution of Defendnot installation via PowerShell one-liner
  that downloads and executes the Defendnot script from a remote URL.

  Defendnot is a hacktool that abuses Microsoft''s undocumented WSC API to disable
  Windows Defender by registering itself as a fake antivirus product.

  '
references:
- https://github.com/es3n1n/defendnot/blob/525176a37721ead27d3f9f77f59b58abfc305988/README.md#one-liner
author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
date: 2026-10-18
tags:
- attack.defense-impairment
- attack.t1685
logsource:
  category: ps_script
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
  - ScriptBlockText|contains: https://dnot.sh/
  - ScriptBlockText|contains|all:
    - /defendnot
    - github
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
- Unlikely
level: high
